name: portfolio-weight-agent
description: Selling your winners and buying your losers is psychologically hard. The agent proposes it; you approve it.

scripts.env:check: node --env-file-if-exists=.env -e "const k=process.env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY;console.log(k?'ANTHROPIC_API_KEY loaded: '+k.slice(0,14)+'...'+k.slice(-4)+' ('+k.length+' chars)':'ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is NOT set — create .env from .env.example');console.log('ANTHROPIC_MODEL:',process.env.ANTHROPIC_MODEL||'claude-sonnet-4-6 (default)')"
